related.title: TLS Delegated Credentials：代理憑證的有效期交集
related.titleEn: TLS Delegated Credentials: delegated authority lifetime intersections
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：600與240秒可重算，舊token與錯受眾反例都拒絕；報告清楚區分輪替觸發、取得及採用三個事件。 交付rotation-read.csv、程序/檔案雙識別記錄及失敗分類；實驗只使用無效合成claims，不呼叫叢集API。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reproduce 600 and 240 seconds and reject both stale-token and wrong-audience counterexamples. The report clearly distinguishes renewal trigger, replacement acquisition and application adoption. Deliver rotation-read.csv, paired process/file identity observations and failure classifications. The experiment uses inert synthetic claims and never calls a real cluster API.
related.difference: 建立父憑證、DelegationUsage、代理公鑰與預期簽章演算法的測試描述；對缺授權、錯演算法及超出父有效期各留一個反例，先寫拒絕理由。
related.differenceEn: Create descriptors for the parent certificate, DelegationUsage authorization, delegated public key and expected signature algorithm. Include missing authorization, wrong algorithm and excessive lifetime as separate counterexamples with decisions written before evaluation.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 在本課短TTL情境，80%TTL輪替觸發早於24小時條件；以到期減觸發與重讀延遲估算餘裕。觸發時刻不是保證完成時刻。 TTL為3600秒，假設輪替即刻成功，程序120秒後重讀；改變情境把重讀延遲增為480秒，其他條件不變。 觸發t=2880秒，基準餘裕3600−2880−120=600秒；延遲後3600−2880−480=240秒。網路重試需另外扣除。
代理驗證包含簽章、演算法與時間要求；本課僅計算已通過其他檢查者的剩餘時間，採父憑證餘期與代理餘期的較小值，不將最小值運算代替協定驗證。 在共同觀測時點，父憑證尚餘7200秒，代理憑證尚餘1800秒；所有描述使用相同UTC時基且在規格允許的期限內。 共同可用時間min(7200,1800)=1800秒；只縮短父餘期至900秒時，變為900秒，不能保留原來的代理餘期結論。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: For the short TTL used here, the 80%-of-TTL trigger precedes the 24-hour condition. Estimate margin by subtracting trigger time and reread delay from expiry; a trigger is not a guarantee of completed renewal. Use a 3600-second TTL, assume immediate successful renewal at the trigger, and reread 120 seconds later. The changed fixture increases reread delay to 480 seconds with other conditions unchanged. Trigger time is 2880 seconds; margin is 3600−2880−120=600 seconds, falling to 240 with delayed rereading. Network retries would require an additional, separately stated deduction.

Delegation requires signature, algorithm and time checks. This exercise calculates remaining time only after the other checks pass, taking the smaller parent and delegated remainder; the minimum operation is not a substitute for protocol validation. At a common observation instant the parent has 7200 seconds remaining and the delegated credential has 1800. Use a shared UTC time base and descriptors within the specification lifetime bounds; do not infer validity from file creation times. The common usable interval is min(7200, 1800)=1800 seconds. Reducing only the parent remainder to 900 makes it 900 seconds; an unchanged delegated descriptor cannot preserve authority beyond its parent.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Open DICE：分層量測變更的相依閉包
related.titleEn: Open DICE: dependency closure after layered measurement changes
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：600與240秒可重算，舊token與錯受眾反例都拒絕；報告清楚區分輪替觸發、取得及採用三個事件。 交付rotation-read.csv、程序/檔案雙識別記錄及失敗分類；實驗只使用無效合成claims，不呼叫叢集API。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reproduce 600 and 240 seconds and reject both stale-token and wrong-audience counterexamples. The report clearly distinguishes renewal trigger, replacement acquisition and application adoption. Deliver rotation-read.csv, paired process/file identity observations and failure classifications. The experiment uses inert synthetic claims and never calls a real cluster API.
related.difference: 建立八層單一路徑L0至L7，記錄每層程式、設定、模式及前層輸入識別；用相依邊解釋為何上層變更可能影響下游派生結果。
related.differenceEn: Build an eight-layer path L0 through L7 with code, configuration, mode and predecessor identifiers. Use dependency edges to explain why an upstream input change can affect downstream derivations rather than treating layer hashes as unrelated inventory fields.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 在本課短TTL情境，80%TTL輪替觸發早於24小時條件；以到期減觸發與重讀延遲估算餘裕。觸發時刻不是保證完成時刻。 TTL為3600秒，假設輪替即刻成功，程序120秒後重讀；改變情境把重讀延遲增為480秒，其他條件不變。 觸發t=2880秒，基準餘裕3600−2880−120=600秒；延遲後3600−2880−480=240秒。網路重試需另外扣除。
本課採簡化模型：改變第k層後，該層及所有後繼均需重新計算，共8−k層；此模型不宣稱涵蓋真實DICE全部憑證與金鑰生命周期。 八層中修改L2，所有測試派生值用公開字串與SHA-256佔位運算；L0與L1輸入固定，沒有任何硬體根秘密。 需重算8−2=6層；改為只修改L5時需重算8−5=3層。兩個情境是獨立變更，不可把六與三相加當單次影響。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: For the short TTL used here, the 80%-of-TTL trigger precedes the 24-hour condition. Estimate margin by subtracting trigger time and reread delay from expiry; a trigger is not a guarantee of completed renewal. Use a 3600-second TTL, assume immediate successful renewal at the trigger, and reread 120 seconds later. The changed fixture increases reread delay to 480 seconds with other conditions unchanged. Trigger time is 2880 seconds; margin is 3600−2880−120=600 seconds, falling to 240 with delayed rereading. Network retries would require an additional, separately stated deduction.

In the simplified model, changing layer k requires recomputation of that layer and every successor, totaling 8−k layers. This dependency exercise does not claim to implement all certificate, key-lifecycle or sealing details of a real DICE platform. Modify L2 in an eight-layer chain. Derivation placeholders use public strings and SHA-256, with L0 and L1 inputs fixed and no hardware root secret. Label these hashes as dependency demonstrations rather than valid device identities. Recompute 8−2=6 layers. In a separate scenario changing only L5 requires 8−5=3. These are independent edits, so adding six and three would misrepresent the impact of either single change.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
